item.title: Domestic disturbance leads to historic charges against man: C-K police
item.description: A woman was assaulted during a domestic disturbance at a Wallaceburg residence on Wednesday, which officers learned wasn’t the first time, said Chatham-Kent police. Officers responded shortly after 2 p.m. and learned the 65-year-old Wallaceburg woman had been assaulted and had suffered historical assaults, police said.
